rationale: The portfolio already holds a 9.9% long position in BIP, which is the direct parent partnership of BIPC and exhibits a 0.93 return correlation. Adding a long position in BIPC would duplicate single-issuer risk when available buying power is already constrained to 16.4%, while initiating a short against strong relative volume (5.39x) and price holding above both VWAP ($41.43) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($41.68) would merely create a spread friction against our existing holding.
